acceptance_criteria.S6B-M-AC-01: exact warmup/canary/switch/drain/unload/rollback identities and phase order pass 3/3
acceptance_criteria.S6B-M-AC-02: accepted loss, duplicate effects, wrong-version responses, transition 5xx, and illegal GPU owner overlap are zero
acceptance_criteria.S6B-M-AC-03: wrong digest fails closed 3/3 with route and Blue serving identity unchanged
acceptance_criteria.S6B-M-AC-04: exact Blue rollback, B0 health, metrics, queue/lease/model unload, and cleanup pass 3/3

claim_boundary: one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, one Triton GPU container, controlled traffic; not production SLA, physical HA, node failover, multi-node, multi-GPU, MIG, MPS, or a zero-interruption guarantee
definition: one top-level exclusive GPU lease and one Triton GPU container host governed Blue and Green model identities; the existing Workloads API controls warmup, 10% canary, switch, in-flight drain, unload, and exact rollback

dependencies.S2: bounded admission and queue invariants retained

engineering_question: Can model-version changes be controlled independently from API Pod rollout with exact digest identity, no lost or duplicate accepted request, no illegal GPU owner overlap, and deterministic rollback?
experiment_purpose: measure model lifecycle interruption, request outcomes, route identity, phase duration, latency, resource usage, and rollback under controlled single-GPU traffic
test_purpose: reject digest mismatch, approval reuse, premature drain, wrong route, stale lease/fence, duplicate effect, rollback mismatch, readiness/canary fail-open, loss, orphan, and cleanup mutations
validation_purpose: recompute route, model, lease, approval, request, trace, monotonic phase, resource, and cleanup invariants from private raw evidence
